fromA: Today a workspace has one member: there is no way to invite anyone.
toB: An admin invites by e-mail, the invitee accepts from the link, and both see the new member in the list.

foundation.intro: Lays the invites table, both routes of the contract and the factories down at once, so the two entries never touch a shared file.

items.what: `POST /invites` and `POST /invites/{token}/accept`, one file per path, and the generated code

proof.expect: exit 0: every generated file is the foundation's and current

entries.name: Send an invite
entries.what: An admin invites by e-mail, within the daily limit.
entries.front: the Invite form and its states

entries.name: Accept an invite
entries.what: The invitee opens the link and joins the workspace.

entries.name: Invite to member
entries.what: The journey from the invite to the new member in the list, on the real routes.

decisions.question: One entry for sending and accepting, or two?
decisions.why: each proves alone on factory data
